newsitem.title: USA: InterAction Media not optimistic about funding.
newsitem.headline: InterAction Media not optimistic about funding.

text.p: InterAction Media Corp said Friday its ability to continue operations is dependent upon immediate additional funding and it has limited expectations of obtaining such financing within the next few weeks.
The company said that without additional funding, it may have to substantially change or cease operations.
InterAction said, as of March 31, it had an accumulated deficit of $4,889,558, a deficiency of working capital of $1,077,764 and stockholders' equity of $997,394.
The company said it has incurred additional losses since that date, which has further decreased its working capital and stockholders' equity.
Organized in December 1994, InterAction develops and operates interactive multimedia shopping locations for colleges and universities, it said.
The company's stock last traded at 1-3/8, down 5/8 from the opening on a volume of 5,600 shares.
